findings.note: The SIBLING half of the confirmed finding animal-instinct#edition, filed as a CROSS-FILE GAP by work/.b035-report-engine-1.txt and re-stated by work/.b035-verify-engine-1.txt. The finding's own proposal reads: "The same mislink is on its four siblings sourced to Player Core 2 - fury-instinct (instinct-3 -> instinct-10), giant-instinct (instinct-4 -> instinct-11), spirit-instinct (instinct-5 -> instinct-12), superstition-instinct (instinct-6 -> instinct-13) - fix them in the same pass so the print-read lane stops being pointed at the CRB text." Of those four, animal-instinct itself is authored by work/.b035-rows-data-rows-2.json and fury-instinct by work/.b035-rows-engine-1.json, so this spec authors the remaining THREE and nothing else - one row per record+field, no collision with any sibling spec. Re-measured off public/core.json and the AoN mirror before authoring: all three carry source.book "Pathfinder Player Core 2" while citing a Core Rulebook / Advanced Player's Guide aonId, and the shipped description of each is a closer word-for-word match to its Player Core 2 page than to the page it cites (giant 0.983 vs 0.943, spirit 0.972 vs 0.877, superstition 0.987 vs 0.775). The `edition: "legacy"` value being superseded was never an authored judgement: scripts/backfill-ast-edition.mjs:111 derives edition FROM the aonId's mirror doc, so the legacy tag is a downstream consequence of the same mis-join and moves with it. NOT claimed here: the picker consequence the read lane REFUTED on superstition-instinct#edition-and-aonid (the barbarian instinct picker is built from cls.subclass.options, which applyEditionFilter never touches). The harm these rows fix is the JOIN - the AoN page the record points at, and the AST prose imported from it, which is the pre-remaster text with different numbers.

backfillRows.why: instinct-11 is "Giant", Source ["Player Core 2"] pg. 75 - the printing this record's own source.book already names. It cited instinct-4, "Giant", Source ["Core Rulebook"] pg. 87, so the join contradicted the record's own source and pointed the print-read lane and the AST import at the pre-remaster text.

Replaces the existing overlay row {classFeatures/giant-instinct/edition: "legacy"} (scripts/data/effect-backfill.json #8365) whole - a scalar, so the superseded value is carried in full by restating it. That row was not a judgement: scripts/backfill-ast-edition.mjs derives `edition` from the aonId's mirror doc, so "legacy" was read off the Core Rulebook page instinct-4 and moves with the corrected join to the Player Core 2 page instinct-11.

instinct-12 is "Spirit", Source ["Player Core 2"] pg. 75. It cited instinct-5, "Spirit", Source ["Core Rulebook"] pg. 87. Same mis-join as its confirmed sibling animal-instinct: the record's source.book is Player Core 2 and its shipped description matches the PC2 page more closely than the page it cites.

Replaces the existing overlay row {classFeatures/spirit-instinct/edition: "legacy"} (scripts/data/effect-backfill.json #8533) whole - a scalar, so the superseded value is carried in full by restating it. That row was not a judgement: scripts/backfill-ast-edition.mjs derives `edition` from the aonId's mirror doc, so "legacy" was read off the Core Rulebook page instinct-5 (name "Spirit", whose own remaster_id field is ["instinct-12"]) and it moves with the corrected join to the Player Core 2 page instinct-12.

instinct-13 is "Superstition", Source ["Player Core 2"] pg. 75. It cited instinct-6, "Superstition", Source ["Advanced Player's Guide"] pg. 108, whose own remaster_id field is ["instinct-13"] - the mirror itself names the successor page. The two printings differ in their numbers (APG: "from 2 to 4 against creatures that can cast spells"; PC2: "from 2 to 3, or 4 against creatures you have witnessed Casting a Spell within the last hour"), and our shipped description is the PC2 one. This record's own finding superstition-instinct#edition-and-aonid is in refuted[], but on its stated CONSEQUENCES only (a picker that applyEditionFilter never touches, and an aonId with no .tsx consumer) - the read lane's verifier wrote "The mistag itself is real". The provenance of this row is the CONFIRMED animal-instinct#edition, whose proposal names superstition-instinct explicitly.

Replaces the existing overlay row {classFeatures/superstition-instinct/edition: "legacy"} (scripts/data/effect-backfill.json #8543) whole - a scalar, so the superseded value is carried in full by restating it. That row was not a judgement: scripts/backfill-ast-edition.mjs derives `edition` from the aonId's mirror doc, so "legacy" was read off the Advanced Player's Guide page instinct-6 (name "Superstition", whose own remaster_id field is ["instinct-13"]) and it moves with the corrected join to the Player Core 2 page instinct-13.
